gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Amazon sells the VIOFO A229 Pro 2CH and the HK4 hardwire kit, which parking mode needs, as one bundle SKU for $299.02. Bought separately on Amazon they cost $279.99 + $25.99 = $305.98, so the bundle is $6.96 cheaper, and ChatGPT showed the camera alone at $329.99.
standout_why: Dashlore (cited) says VIOFO parking mode needs an optional HK4 or HK6 kit, but only for the A229 Ultra, A329S and A119M Pro. It gives launch prices only and names no bundle (the WebFetch summary: 'No pick is described as a bundle'). It also treats HK4 and HK6 as interchangeable, while VIOFO's own Amazon listings split them by camera. Technobezz (cited) returned HTTP 403, so I could not check it. I did not open the uncited top results (redlinecargarage, dashcamempire, roadgearlab, gearnudge), so I can't rule them out. ChatGPT's own answer says only that a hardwire kit is 'optional' and shows the A229 Pro at $329.99 with no kit in the cart.
kit_items: dash cam: VIOFO A229 Pro 2CH (4K front + 2K rear). It is ChatGPT's 'pick for most drivers' and is on Amazon at $279.99 today.

parking power: VIOFO HK4 Type-C hardwire kit with 8 fuse taps. VIOFO's Amazon title lists it for the A229 series. The HK6 is listed for the A329S and A119M Pro instead, so the HK6 is the wrong kit for this camera.
storage: SanDisk High Endurance microSD 256 GB (or 128 GB). It is a dash-cam/surveillance endurance card; parking mode records around the clock and wears ordinary cards.
